description: "On the Reception of the 'Origin of Species' by Thomas Henry Huxley" is a scientific publication authored by Professor Thomas Henry Huxley, a prominent figure in the field of biology during the late 19th century. In this work, Huxley discusses how Charles Darwin's seminal book, "The Origin of Species," was received by the scientific community and the general public after its publication.
